programme.desc: 位于泰国的湄公河沿岸是温带与热带的交界;跟随摄制队沿着河流穿越金三角,欣赏该区众多鸟类的求偶舞,再一同参与水灵祭典。

programme.title: 拉斐尔纳达尔: 红土球王
programme.desc: 这部纪录片深入探讨网球传奇拉斐尔纳达尔的人生,探索他从神童成长为全球巨星的历程。透过众多胜利和挑战揭示拿度在球场内外所贡献的遗产。(V374)

programme.title: 克林伊斯威特: 自得其乐
programme.desc: 奇连伊士活是一个演员、导演和慈善家。从典型的西方偶像,到磨练他的技艺和关怀的个性。这就是他波澜壮阔的人生故事。

programme.title: 玛丽亚凯莉: 毅力与魅力
programme.desc: 玛丽亚凯莉的人生宛如童话般的灰姑娘故事。至尊歌后、圣诞女王、热心公益的慈善家——她已售出超过 22 亿张唱片,并推出史上最畅销的圣诞专辑。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #1
programme.desc: 专访玛丹娜第一任经理人卡缪巴庞、舞者卡尔顿威尔邦、艾薇塔工作室执行官罗伦莱等人。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #3
programme.desc: 占美解释为何北领地顶端地带拥有全国最好、最新鲜的海鲜;他在达尔文码头遇到自学成才的厨师瑞秋西索卡,并学习如何烹制她的招牌菜- 柠檬柚子泥蟹。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #4
programme.desc: 占美前往偏远的曼宁立达的阿纳姆地沿海社区,在丛林中品尝美食。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #5
programme.desc: 占美在帕华普周末市集的档摊品尝达尔文的流行街头小食;并讨论达尔文对叻沙的迷恋。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #6
programme.desc: 占美跟卡卡杜的风景打卡;他与原住民梅曼迪聊天,他带著占美沿著黄水河游船河饱览她的国家。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #7
programme.desc: 达尔文唯一的朱古力师里奥健弗斯带占美参观自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #8
programme.desc: 占美参观达尔文市中心,给自己的餐厅哈纽文一些建议,并烹制他儿时最喜欢的菜式之一。

programme.title: 恐龙效应
programme.desc: 《恐龙效应》是一部关于现今加拿大古生物学复兴的纪录片,恐龙能怎样教导我们有关气候变化的知识。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #1
programme.desc: 主持人米克大卫臣前往巴西,一群巨型发电船正处于解决当地逼切的电力需求的最后阶段。它们对抗风浪,赶在限期前为200万户家庭提供尽可能多的电力。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #2
programme.desc: 主持人米克大卫臣前往智利偏远的阿塔卡马沙漠,到访地球上最令人难以置信、最复杂的天文台之一- ALMA。他与ALMA的专家团一起修复一些世上最大的天线。

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #6
programme.desc: 在爱尔兰,双胞胎与伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球对决、传统舞蹈、《哈利波特》回忆杀,并揭开诡谲迷人的乡间冒险序幕!

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年来制作海南鸡饭的心得。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #2
programme.desc: 廖崇明从当地穆斯林家庭学习制作正宗巴东牛肉。他到访新加坡国家档案馆查找母亲家族的资料,并继续寻找新加坡国宴的灵感。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #3
programme.desc: 廖崇明到访峇峇娘惹美食传奇人物温美玉的餐厅- 国家厨房。然后,他前往牛车水参观澳洲人大卫偏特的餐厅- Burnt Ends。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明寻找新加坡最好的海鲜。他从滨海湾金沙酒店出发,那里有许多名厨开设的餐厅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #5
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛顿熟食中心,继续寻找海鲜灵感。他教授了如何安排一场独一无二海鲜盛宴的大师班。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明从新加坡动物园的传统早餐,包括咖央多士、温泉蛋和咖啡开始,寻找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #7
programme.desc: 为了寻找最适合国宴的食材,廖崇明到访色彩缤纷的芽笼蔬果市场以及米芝莲星级餐厅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #8
programme.desc: 在鸡尾酒会期间,从峇峇娘惹的私房甜品到精致的甜品吧,廖崇明发现了一些新加坡最好的甜品。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #9
programme.desc: 廖崇明把过去几周所学到的知识融汇贯通,为包括他母亲在内的一些贵客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年来制作海南鸡饭的心得。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #1

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天温和潮湿,对不同动物来说,是好消息,也可以是坏消息。欧洲马鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文鱼已经半年没有食物,山兔变成了显眼的白色,松鼠将自己的幼崽赶出巢穴。

programme.title: 冰岛: 海鹦保护区
programme.desc: 讨人喜欢、被视为「滑稽」的海鹦是冰岛的国家象征,但牠的命运令人担忧。长达十年,海鹦伴侣停止繁殖。少数当地热心人士现已动员起来,力挽狂澜,拯救这种备受喜爱的海鸟。

programme.title: 巨型长毛象的足迹
programme.desc: 这具百万年历史的巨大杜尔福长毛象骨骸,急需进行世界首创的紧急修复。我们跟随这个艰巨的拆卸和重组脆弱化石的过程。透过电脑成像技术(CGI)和博物馆知识,这部影片让这个引人入胜却鲜为人知的巨型生物重获「生命」。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了独特的野生生态。从南部的西班牙栓皮栎森林到北部的落叶林,从交配到野外生存,跟随标志性物种所经历的关键生命阶段。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 现在是六月,公园沐浴在17个小时的日光之中。温暖的气温带来了丰收,但对新生儿来说,夏季很重要,因牠们要学习战斗、觅食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿争相繁殖、鱼鹰雏鸟开展3000英里西非迁徙、三文鱼返回牠们出生的河流、极北蝰产子的季节。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 罗莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天温和潮湿,对不同动物来说,是好消息,也可以是坏消息。欧洲马鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文鱼已经半年没有食物,山兔变成了显眼的白色,松鼠将自己的幼崽赶出巢穴。

programme.title: 冰岛: 海鹦保护区
programme.desc: 讨人喜欢、被视为「滑稽」的海鹦是冰岛的国家象征,但牠的命运令人担忧。长达十年,海鹦伴侣停止繁殖。少数当地热心人士现已动员起来,力挽狂澜,拯救这种备受喜爱的海鸟。

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt gets to play matchmaker when three fallow deer trade their bachelor days for life with a 120-strong female deer herd But first Matt must dart the deer and remove their antlers -V so the pressure's really on The abandoned baby badger has trebled in size, but back in the surgery, a tiny water dragon is in for a tricky operation There's good news for two rescued stray cats when they find a luxury new home - and at Flamingoland, Matt lets the ring-tailed lemurs out into their brand new enclosure after a winter spent indoors

programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes arranges a warrant to rescue four dogs from a dangerously overcrowded house After an unfriendly welcome it becomes clear that at least one of the dogs will need medical attention but their diagnosis turns out much more serious than expected

programme.desc: In The Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes is called out to a shocking case where nine year old German Shepherd Reo has been left with an awful skin condition Despite scratching so much that her face is covered in open sores she is still able to muster a wag of the tail, but will she have the strength to overcome her painful condition?

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts"nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show" These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title

programme.title: Snake Master
programme.desc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home

programme.title: Survive The Wild
programme.desc: From microscopic single celled organisms to the largest animals on the planet, one goal is shared by all living things: to reproduce

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that live in the shadows and the adaptations they need to survive…Nocturnal animals have taken to this dark world for good reason: they escape predators, avoid the heat of the day, and take their turn sharing food and resources in their ‘niche’ But to navigate life in the dark, you need some special abilities to cope with the lack of light

programme.title: Shark Gordon
programme.desc: Tiger sharks are responsible for more attacks on humans than any other shark aside from the great white But do they actively prey on humans at beaches, or are these just chance encounter?

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.desc: This episode explores how creatures like spitting cobras, jellyfish, and wasps use distance weapons—venomous stingers or chemical sprays—to immobilize or repel threats

programme.title: 英雄王,为了穷尽武道而转生~而后成为世界最强见习骑士♀~ #1
programme.desc: 被称为英雄王的老国王英格利斯为王国和人民奉献了一生。面临人生最终时刻的他向女神亚莉丝泰尔许愿,表示若能重生便想毕生专精武艺。他转生为名叫英格莉丝的女性后,在还是婴儿时就学会凝聚灵素,击倒魔石兽。 五岁时便能闭著眼打赢偷用魔术的拉哈尔。

programme.title: 英雄王,为了穷尽武道而转生~而后成为世界最强见习骑士♀~ #2
programme.desc: 英格莉丝和拉菲妮亚在六岁时为了成为骑士而参加受洗。拉菲妮亚获得上级魔印,但英格莉丝却自愿成为无印者。十二岁时两人前往王都,巧遇天上人的拉哈尔,并在圣骑士里昂的介绍下结识天惠武姬的厄丽丝。深夜时,与厄丽丝相遇的英格莉丝决定借此机会与她切磋。

programme.title: 英雄王,为了穷尽武道而转生~而后成为世界最强见习骑士♀~ #3
programme.desc: 里昂赶到遭天上人重创的厄丽丝面前,受够天上人蛮横行为的他决定加入反天上人组织「血铁锁旅团」。巨大的魔石兽突然出现并袭击拉菲妮亚,英格莉丝为了保护她将其击倒,然而对方竟是喝下虹粉药的拉哈尔。之后成为十五岁的两人为了进入骑士学院而前往王都。

programme.title: 英雄王,为了穷尽武道而转生~而后成为世界最强见习骑士♀~ #4
programme.desc: 英格莉丝与天惠武姬之一的希丝缇亚对峙,两人展开激烈的攻防战。对方使出致命一击,但英格莉丝成功扭转战况,击败对手。事后执政官席兰妮赦免了反叛骑士的罪行并宣布关于天上领的新计划。她却因为服用虹粉药变成魔石兽,遭血铁锁旅团的首领黑假面男攻击。

programme.title: 海贼王 #43
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

高朋满座#92粤
programme.desc: 喜与悦这对煲剧迷又再拿出经典名剧《神经侠侣》重看。庆宣布家人将参加筹款话剧，要朋改篇《神经侠侣》。喜与悦均感自己可任小龙女一角，但最终由蕙婷演出。众家人因只当闲角，彼此在排练时纷纷「爆肚」捣乱。

programme.title: 尚食#32粤普
programme.desc: 皇后因涉嫌谋害子衿而被软禁，瞻基更直言要废后，朝臣纷纷进言劝谏，加上京畿地区发生地震，大臣们更认为此乃上天的警示，汉王借机准备谋反大计。吴昭仪假意与子衿探望皇后，却用香薰迷晕皇后，欲借此陷害子衿…

programme.title: 阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷请阿谭品尝无米鸡粥，吃前利用隔筛即可分开稀粥、稠粥。既然有一锅无米粥，不妨花点工夫渌熟海鲜料，来个美味海鲜大杂汇！阿爷豪迈地选用A5和牛制作肉饼，不需加入肥猪肉来增添油脂。除了混入陈皮与沙葛之外，鼎爷还反传统香煎肉饼，而非采取蒸煮的烹调方式？甜豆、荷兰豆怎样分辨？桌上一粒粒青色的豆，竟不是青豆而是墨豆。鼎爷于每条甜豆斩一刀，打算将虾胶酿进去再煎。事前他却先把所有豆粒取出再跟虾胶混合，有何原因？

programme.title: 渣打香港呈献：财富之道粤
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈献：财富之道》，每集邀请各界精英与银行专家，在轻松氛围下畅谈财富投资热话，包括财富管理、AI投资、利率走势、医疗保险及多元资产配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 炎夏日子，增加洗澡频率无可厚非，皮肤科医生却提到皮肤有一道屏障，过度清洁或会诱发湿疹？认知「过度」定义后，再了解致病原因。不过,，若遇皮肤干燥或湿疹急性发作，怎样清洁皮肤才恰当？母亲节临近，想为妈妈送上惊喜，主持们替观众向花艺专家请教。除康乃馨外，甚么较新式的花材适合赠予母亲？专家展示送赠配搭之余，还会示范插花技巧，呈现秀雅的花盒作品。另外，傅季馨师傅在「睇𩠌食饭」，炮制脆皮版「咖喱牛肋条」。

programme.title: 医度讲粤
programme.desc: 经痛可说是女人之苦，更有人表示痛过生仔！本集「医度讲」，陈欣茵到来诉说如何受经痛问题困扰，另外也有妇科医生周天欣为大家解构经痛的迷思。而注册中医师何慧欣、营养师李澄琳，也会在节目分享有助舒缓经痛的食疗与相关穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#24粤
programme.desc: 若岚因为飞扬与永祯起冲突再旧病复发变回少女模样，而因九妹离开，喜相逢又陷进困境。飞扬提出入股，而控制权交给九妹，双春爽快答应。双春阻止永祯对付飞扬时，之科通知永祯胜天遇意外，胜天康复时，永祯决定放弃追寻父亲之死的隐情。大贵的首领大哥雄突然出现，要胁飞扬替他走私国宝。永祯为了夺回「省港澳厨艺比试」的参赛权，用计接近主办的南天王；永祯得知若岚装傻以查探真相。众人欲登船前往香港作赛时，突然有缉私队出现。

programme.title: 奇妙的动物之动物新纪录粤普
programme.desc: 什么动物腿最多？什么动物最爱干净？什么动物最长寿？想知道这些动物界神奇的世界纪录吗？快和皮皮龙一起走进奇妙的动物世界吧！探索动物新纪录，神奇发现全记住！

programme.title: 奇妙的动物之动物新纪录粤普

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 这集参与「WORKOUT 2GETHER」的小朋友都获分配一个气球，却非玩乐之用，而是要训练腹部肌肉！在瑜伽垫上坐好，抬起双脚，留空位让气球可绕过双脚，又试试用脚夹紧气球时将身体滚动，要好好用力才不会令气球溜走！搬走地下的瑜伽垫，换成一张合适高度的座椅，藉椅子做两款深蹲来强化下肢肌肉。如发觉两只脚的肌肉力量有所不同，就是时候多做锻练。接着转成面向椅子，连续做「登山者式」，记得要按稳椅子以免其移动。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 在千依帮助下，阿纺摆脱牢笼，与阳葵美月重逢。正当阿纺想把偶像公主空间恢复原状，黑暗Quartet STAR现身阻挠。由于阳葵二人将友情能量分给了阿纺，已没有能量进行演唱会，为了保护她俩，阿纺决定单独挑战黑暗Quartet STAR。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝粤
programme.desc: 香港早于五十年代初期，由于当时的房屋供应短缺，为了解决居住问题，政府拨地给居民兴建这些平房，一些居民已经数代在这里居住，不过平房区的土地属于政府，所以政府说清拆时，居民不会得到任何赔偿，但部分居民指清拆不合理，新闻掏宝和大家重温2000年专题。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤

汇丰保险呈献 :准备退休有乜计粤

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 中医师提到，女性于分娩过程或导致气血亏虚、筋骨大开、肾精亏损，因此坐月调理尤为重要。医师细谈坐月期间分阶段调理的膳食重点，并介绍可舒缓产后情绪的穴位按压方法。提升儿童软实力有助增强专注力、执行功能、情绪管理。透过记忆游戏、角色扮演，小朋友能于轻松氛围下作训练，「老师话」、「煮饭仔」均是合适的选择。家长陪伴孩子玩游戏时，有甚么要注意？「睇𩠌食饭」环节，Annie师傅示范一道「酱烧猪软骨」。

programme.title: 医度讲粤
programme.desc: 香港据称约有25%人符合强迫症的症状，即全港约有近十八万人有强迫症的思想或行为，情况值得关注。《医度讲》这次有何泳芍到来细谈其疑似强迫症倾向，还有精神科医生曹国柱为大家解构强迫症问题与相关迷思，而注册中医师何慧欣联同营养师李澄琳，也会在本集提供可缓解强迫症症状的食疗和穴位，记得收看！

programme.title: 五味人生#25粤PG
programme.desc: (大结局)缉私队发现船上藏有黄金及大批国宝；飞扬指是永祯策画走私。永祯主动认罪把所有罪名揹上身……拜神中的飞扬与若岚被带至废屋，大哥雄要飞扬想办法把国宝偷回。飞扬发现若岚装傻，竟把她绑架回家。胜天自二人对话中发现一切都是飞扬的计谋，不禁崩溃……双春与利是妹营救永祯。若岚与胜天游说飞扬自首，但曼娣抢去飞扬的手枪，更向若岚开火……九妹、永祯与双春不敌大哥雄，大哥雄提出在三人中只放过一人……

programme.title: 高朋满座#93粤
programme.desc: 义前去跟进麻烦客人时，发现麻烦客是三妗婆。三妗婆强拉义等喝茶，期间行径令人侧目，更要求到高家过夜。三妗婆尖酸刻薄的说话令家中各人苦不堪言，众人唯有迫义尽快完成保险计划书，可是当义完成后，她却失去踪影！

programme.title: 尚食#33粤普PG
programme.desc: 越来越多灾民涌入京城，京城储粮不足，太后操劳成疾。孟尚宫著人储存的守山粮为京城百姓带来生机。皇后不顾安危到医所亲自为民众治病而染上疾病。汉王率叛军控制皇城，危急关头皇后病重，子衿坚守在她身边。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 从太平山顶居高临下，尽是香港繁华盛景。掌故专家郑宝鸿登上山顶竟说要「揾老衬」，何出此言？「咸鱼就饭，锅底刮烂」，一道「咸鱼蒸肉饼」成为多代港人的家常美食，且随主持们前往咸鱼店舖访寻「梅香」滋味。「老笠」、「派头」等由外文演变而成的地道俗语，译得㜺鬼又过瘾！中文讲师廖舜禧还解读「唔食广东米」的意思。师傅亲手雕啄而成的手工麻雀，揉合香港文化与传统工艺，主持尝试照做，相信只会「麻雀追飞机－ 枉费心机」！

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 所谓「单料铜煲，一滚就熟」，铜制家品尽显精湛的手作工艺，并非新潮家品能够比拟；且看铜器店主展示这种日渐失传的民间绝学。广东人常以「三只手」借代小偷、窃匪，㜺鬼说法竟源于「看图识字」？「乌龙」前身实是忠心护主的小狗，俗语「摆乌龙」又是否来自一场误会？「食得禾米多」等不少俗语亦跟动物有关，留意今集讲解。砧板做出来后便是「木鱼命－ 挨打」，一块优质砧板使用数十年依然坚固无比，制作过程有何秘密？

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
香料密码粤普
programme.desc: 从辣椒的火辣到肉豆蔻的辛香，从胡椒的辛辣到香草的芬芳，节目细腻呈现香料的个性与历史，探讨它们的特质，逐步揭开它们的神秘面纱，展现舌尖与香料交织的奇妙融合。

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粤
programme.desc: 诺懿为嘉欣、君馨和子羚亲制健康早餐，谁知她们早已吃饱，完美错过诺懿的心机。三女换上「下田」装束，走进生态园仿热带雨林温室，采摘玻璃屋餐厅会用到的葡萄、罗勒叶与茄子原食材。集齐食材后，她们要设计Cafe专属餐单，诺懿放心让三女下厨，岂料要兼任「洗碗男」！女主持合力炮制自家盛宴，渐渐培养出默契。入夜，她们满心期待首次试菜，主打的「一口茄子批」却临门一脚失手？诺懿还相赠富心思的罗勒幼苗，为三人打打气。

programme.title: 奇迹小店粤
programme.desc: 面对疫情与加租夹击，经营逾三十年的港式饼店无奈结业，幸遇奇迹降临，老板夫妇在原舖旁重新开炉。招牌角仔藏感人故事，老板娘回想为癌症病人达成临终心愿，感触不已！制饼业劳心劳力，第二代传人不怕辛苦，用心继承父母心血。怀旧忌廉筒买少见少，有饼店老字号却坚持用本地面粉兼人手搓制。老板由学徒做起，并接手饼店逾三十年，亲切笑脸背后，其实肩负不少压力，甚么是他永不言退的动力？肥妈亦客串收银员，感受浓厚街坊情。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 过敏症是身体警号，也是免疫系统对致敏原所产生的防御反应。谷主汛文提到对猫毛敏感，滢仴则容易因环境引发皮肤过敏。凯文就「过敏症」主题作出资料搜集，并为拍档们带来呼吸道、皮肤、食物的过敏相关资讯。如出现严重过敏反应，有机会危及生命安全，因此预防尤为重要。谷主们讨论如何建立低敏感生活习惯，滢仴提醒洗澡水温度过高与熬夜都可能有影响，汛文则认为保持家居清洁是关键。此外，陪伴大家睡觉的毛公仔或是致敏元凶？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 一路前行II粤普
programme.desc: 节目由胡歌、刘涛和陈龙携手中国国家地理融媒体中心主任张辰亮以及一众新朋友，在节目中带观众走进自然，走进科学研究员、环保爱好者和当地居民的生活工作。

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 一男一女小朋友蒙眼让发型师转换发型，其他孩子都赞赏二人的新造型，当事人脱下眼罩却相视大笑！永城让五位小朋友各自创作艺术画，主题、用色、风格都大有不同。五幅作品会在艺廊展出，并请来专业艺术顾问与不同界别的人士评价、投票。虽然孩子们对自己的作品稍欠自信，但家长都对子女信心十足，最终票选结果如何？经历三集的「美丑」课堂，有小朋友认识到内在美的重要性，也有人发现自己比想像中更爱美，还领略出活在当下的道理？

programme.title: 溜走的真味粤
programme.desc: 卤水鹅是不少人心目中的潮州代表菜式，并大多是选用体型庞大兼肉嫩多汁的狮头鹅炮制。三位主持前往狮头鹅养殖场，从源头了解美味秘密，德哥顺道分享拣鹅心得。与嘉宾薛家燕一同享用全鹅宴，奉客的头盘「鹅掌冻」完全吃不到骨骼，原来是分子料理；「卤老鹅头」，三姐称口感像花胶！陈年卤水亦可充当火锅汤底，烚煮鹅心等食材，别具风味。在鹅场旁，三姐就地取材烹调「凉瓜焖鹅掌翼」、「西红茄鹅杂煮鹅蛋」等，端出最新鲜的真味。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤PG
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 阿井即将被删除，Delta向太晴求助，请他帮忙一起搭建元宇宙版磁浮铁路馆，让阿井能在里面工作。在伊奈和其他铁路部成员相助下，元宇宙及时完成，但伊奈却带来坏消息，便是阿井程式太旧无法更新。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 手脚不协调的情况常常发生？跟随儿童体适能教练「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，有助改善协调能力，还可顺道提升平衡力。踢脚碰手、前后脚交替跳，可有难度？小朋友依照教练举起不同颜色的色碟，做出深蹲、深蹲跳、平板支撑等指定动作，也能考验反应与耐力。第二阶段训练，先手持气球，轮流触碰膝盖和脚跟，节奏加快就可能会乱！单脚抬起，将气球围绕身体转圈，然后手持气球做开合跳，讲求一定运动量，大家又能否应付得来？

programme.desc: 赖慰玲的八岁儿子也也，对一切有关飞机的都感兴趣，更对飞机型号十分熟悉。廿年后，机师可会被AI取代？连妈妈也担心过，却提到会一直支持儿子追梦。也也获安排在机长和慰玲的陪同下，驾驶价值二亿的模拟器，机长更「准备」了突发情况，也也亦冷静完成飞行任务！另一日，也也要「撇下」妈妈并于机长指导下操控真小型飞机，从容飞一转后，机长对其表现有何评价？随后，一段以也也做主角，由AI生成的成长片段，还让慰玲感动落泪。

programme.desc: 音准、拍子大考验，唱歌随时有钱落袋！近期获颁「最佳原创电影歌曲」奖项的歌手黄淑蔓接受《唱钱》洗礼，透过挑战Sing盘上不同歌曲难度「过三关」，甚至是最难的Monster关卡，向打爆九宫格的目标进发。观众只需用手机扫描萤幕上的QR Code，即可参与直播室互动，为挑战者打气，更有机会赢取福利。

programme.title: 伯乐音乐学院20周年呈献：J Music粤
programme.desc: 《魔音女团》其中十五位练习生唱出<下一站天后，四队玩「看图估歌仔」游戏，结果如何？梁钊峰接受半月板手术后，萌生新歌<半月办好概念，并要将歌曲送给爱逞强之人？吴欣彤以快歌<Starlight，寄语大家无需拘束随心而行。女团Honey Punch主打跳唱，初试唱情歌<楼上的姐姐，遇到甚么困难？本集另会倒数「劲歌金榜」二十位排名，张德兰亦受访，诉说将于红馆开个唱纪念入行60年的缘份。

programme.title: 风味人间 第2季粤
programme.desc: 在黑龙江的冰天雪地中，将散养的土鸡配以风干草菇煮成小鸡炖蘑菇，是当地民众的立冬美食。非洲的纳米比亚人亦会将鸡只放养，因运动量大被称为「马拉松鸡」。肉质独特，仅以简单烹调就滋味非常。韩国大邱的市民则会将糯米、红枣等酿入鸡只中炖煮，制成夏日补身妙品人参鸡汤。炸鸡于当地亦深受欢迎，男女老少皆爱吃。安徽的黄淮地区，鸡丝汤是普及早点之一。另有著名的符离集烧鸡，卤制后鸡皮甘香诱人，成为地方代表菜肴。

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 一百米跑香港纪录保持者叶景维、二百米跑代表梁靖恒分别荣膺田总公开组与青年组的最佳男子运动员，两飞人分享得奖感受与短跑心得。香港首次举办国际瑜伽体式运动比赛，瑜伽达人讲述赛制形式。三位本地运动员细谈赛艇的意义，坚持、纪律都是要点。五人冰球赛青少年组结束，搜罗不同组别的决赛精华。短道速滑女将林静欣早前出战冬奥以第七名完赛，获颁发奖金作表扬。另送上世界女排联赛香港站记招、本地帆船赛与学界合球赛花絮。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
叠影狙击#21粤PG
programme.desc: 雄透露曦就是金夫人，并且证实晨是警察卧底的真相，诺震惊不已；晨表示现在只向钱看，但诺不信，要求她对付晟杰来表示诚意；晨和诺拷问龙少，要他说出金夫人的秘密，龙少透露曦偷了杰的犯罪证据，因此二人反目成仇…

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 奇迹小店粤
programme.desc: 面对疫情与加租夹击，经营逾三十年的港式饼店无奈结业，幸遇奇迹降临，老板夫妇在原舖旁重新开炉。招牌角仔藏感人故事，老板娘回想为癌症病人达成临终心愿，感触不已！制饼业劳心劳力，第二代传人不怕辛苦，用心继承父母心血。怀旧忌廉筒买少见少，有饼店老字号却坚持用本地面粉兼人手搓制。老板由学徒做起，并接手饼店逾三十年，亲切笑脸背后，其实肩负不少压力，甚么是他永不言退的动力？肥妈亦客串收银员，感受浓厚街坊情。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 过敏症是身体警号，也是免疫系统对致敏原所产生的防御反应。谷主汛文提到对猫毛敏感，滢仴则容易因环境引发皮肤过敏。凯文就「过敏症」主题作出资料搜集，并为拍档们带来呼吸道、皮肤、食物的过敏相关资讯。如出现严重过敏反应，有机会危及生命安全，因此预防尤为重要。谷主们讨论如何建立低敏感生活习惯，滢仴提醒洗澡水温度过高与熬夜都可能有影响，汛文则认为保持家居清洁是关键。此外，陪伴大家睡觉的毛公仔或是致敏元凶？

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粤
programme.desc: 诺懿为嘉欣、君馨和子羚亲制健康早餐，谁知她们早已吃饱，完美错过诺懿的心机。三女换上「下田」装束，走进生态园仿热带雨林温室，采摘玻璃屋餐厅会用到的葡萄、罗勒叶与茄子原食材。集齐食材后，她们要设计Cafe专属餐单，诺懿放心让三女下厨，岂料要兼任「洗碗男」！女主持合力炮制自家盛宴，渐渐培养出默契。入夜，她们满心期待首次试菜，主打的「一口茄子批」却临门一脚失手？诺懿还相赠富心思的罗勒幼苗，为三人打打气。

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 一男一女小朋友蒙眼让发型师转换发型，其他孩子都赞赏二人的新造型，当事人脱下眼罩却相视大笑！永城让五位小朋友各自创作艺术画，主题、用色、风格都大有不同。五幅作品会在艺廊展出，并请来专业艺术顾问与不同界别的人士评价、投票。虽然孩子们对自己的作品稍欠自信，但家长都对子女信心十足，最终票选结果如何？经历三集的「美丑」课堂，有小朋友认识到内在美的重要性，也有人发现自己比想像中更爱美，还领略出活在当下的道理？

programme.title: 溜走的真味粤
programme.desc: 卤水鹅是不少人心目中的潮州代表菜式，并大多是选用体型庞大兼肉嫩多汁的狮头鹅炮制。三位主持前往狮头鹅养殖场，从源头了解美味秘密，德哥顺道分享拣鹅心得。与嘉宾薛家燕一同享用全鹅宴，奉客的头盘「鹅掌冻」完全吃不到骨骼，原来是分子料理；「卤老鹅头」，三姐称口感像花胶！陈年卤水亦可充当火锅汤底，烚煮鹅心等食材，别具风味。在鹅场旁，三姐就地取材烹调「凉瓜焖鹅掌翼」、「西红茄鹅杂煮鹅蛋」等，端出最新鲜的真味。

programme.title: 香料密码粤普
programme.desc: 从辣椒的火辣到肉豆蔻的辛香，从胡椒的辛辣到香草的芬芳，节目细腻呈现香料的个性与历史，探讨它们的特质，逐步揭开它们的神秘面纱，展现舌尖与香料交织的奇妙融合。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫经商失败！崔明吉调包财阀孙女只为让女儿入豪门】琴英淑是一位爱女心切的母亲，性格温厚，在丈夫生意失败时，她也从不抱怨，自愿到殷会长的家里担任管家。女儿京慧出生时便被诊断出心脏疾病，当时家境也很难提供好的医疗资源。在一场车祸中，她意外的将女儿京慧，与财阀孙女世妍互相掉包身分，本该是千金小姐的世妍也因此变为平凡人，在百货担任精品店职员，而京慧更是直接跃升为财团富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，发现原本属于她的富贵人生全被京慧夺走，愤怒之下她改名换姓，决定拿回属于她的一切。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴叙俊回归携手《鱿鱼2》元志安《等待京道》谱十年宿命恋】十年后的重逢，让李京道与徐智友再度陷入爱情的漩涡。曾是彼此初恋的两人，如今一个是追寻真相的记者，一个是丑闻风暴中的名门继承人。再见面时，他们早已不是年少时的模样，却依然在对方身上看见过去的自己。爱情与现实的距离，在一次次试探与退让间拉扯，他们明知前方满是荆棘，仍选择再次并肩。

programme.title: 暖阳之下
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.title: 白夜童话
programme.desc: 【《绅士与小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飙复仇抛夫弃子生母】从小遭母亲抛弃，加上父亲早逝，白夜与哥哥相依为命，性格坚强好胜的她总对哥哥百般依赖，也因嫉妒哥哥与大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁难怀孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分头疼。某天哥哥与生母连络上，面对母亲拒绝相认，哥哥内心大受打击，一晃神就因交通意外不幸离世，得知此事的白夜便将所有愤怒转向母亲，展开一系列的报复计划。

programme.title: 不屈的儿媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危机寡媳爱上财团之子】拥有三百年历史的宗族大家庭「满月堂」，却深陷男人短命、香火将断的宿命。长孙媳吴英心与丈夫结婚十年始终未能生育，却在丈夫骤逝后被迫守寡；另一孙媳慧媛则遭丈夫抛弃。家族愁云惨雾之际，爱情却悄然来临，两位孙媳分别爱上财团之子，就连守节多年的婆婆也动了凡心。当传统与情感正面冲突，满月堂的女人们，究竟该守著祖训终老，还是勇敢追求属于自己的幸福？

programme.title: Remember-儿子的战争
programme.desc: 【俞承豪为父申冤，朴敏英成为他正义路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇拥有过目不忘的记忆力，为了替被诬陷为杀人犯的父亲申冤成为了律师，与权势贪腐正面对抗。与坚守正义的检察官李仁雅，从质疑到并肩作战，成为振宇最坚强的后盾。就在逐步逼近真相时，却发现自己正逐渐失去记忆。他们携手在权力夹缝中拚搏，在时间与遗忘赛跑，只为守护真相与心中那份信念与爱。

programme.title: 我把社长解锁了
programme.desc: 【人气网漫改编，影帝朴星雄解密手机AI的技术奇幻职场剧！】国内市占率最高的科技公司创办人天才CEO金成柱，因突发事件被杀手追杀成了谋杀案受害者，灵魂尚未离开人世而换个方式存活在刚大学毕业出社会朴仁成的手机内。为找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO开始两人的合作。

programme.title: 君九龄
programme.desc: 九龄公主生性善良，喜好医术，一场阴谋使得她失去至亲，骨肉分离，容貌大变。为了查清真相报仇雪恨，九龄隐姓埋名一直蛰伏，靠著坚强的毅力和意志力，苦练技艺，不放过任何蛛丝马迹，最终发现这场阴谋背后还有一段不为人知的皇室辛秘。知晓真相后的九龄，回到京城，在凶手不断的骚扰和攻击中建立了医馆九龄堂，济世救人，受人尊崇。与此同时，朱瓒与清贵公子宁云钊、前夫陆云旗、方家独子方承宇，身份各异、关系复杂的四人，陷入了以九龄为核心的感情漩涡。谁才是九龄的真命天子？

programme.desc: 【俞承豪为父申冤，朴敏英成为他正义路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇拥有过目不忘的记忆力，为了替被诬陷为杀人犯的父亲申冤成为了律师，与权势贪腐正面对抗。与坚守正义的检察官李仁雅，从质疑到并肩作战，成为振宇最坚强的后盾。就在逐步逼近真相时，却发现自己正逐渐失去记忆。他们携手在权力夹缝中拚搏，在时间与遗忘赛跑，只为守护真相与心中那份信念与爱。

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴(完)
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 逆转女王
programme.desc: 【经典韩剧《贤内助女王》姊妹作】黄泰熙原是高薪的开发组长，但为了追求幸福家庭，她选择与新同事奉俊秀结婚。然而她的决定，却让她被信任的女上司赶出公司，只能在家当贤内助。五年后，泰熙感到现实生活的沉重，决定重返职场。在公司她遇见了具勇植，一位支持她的本部长。泰熙在勇植的鼓励下展现出更坚韧的一面，最终成功东山再起，找到了新的事业目标。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.desc: 拥有预知梦能力的洪珠，因总是只能梦见未来却无力改变而让她痛苦。不是金汤匙出生也没有优秀的学历及人脉，却总是富有充满正义感的检察官宰璨。两人的相遇为了阻止梦境的可怕事件变成现实，开始相信对方是否能成为扭转未来的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花总相逢
programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 人气封锁中:UserNotFound(完)
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同时作为转学生的机率，是旼财意想不到的巧合。与作为人气女王敏在协议交换身份生活，原本逐渐透明的生活开始画上色彩。随著时间害怕被拆穿，同时只在敏在面前直率的申义俊，在他的陪伴与守护找到自我。

programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.title: 人气封锁中:UserNotFound(完)
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同时作为转学生的机率，是旼财意想不到的巧合。与作为人气女王敏在协议交换身份生活，原本逐渐透明的生活开始画上色彩。随著时间害怕被拆穿，同时只在敏在面前直率的申义俊，在他的陪伴与守护找到自我。

programme.title: 红天机
programme.desc: 【国民妹妹金裕贞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭时旸众多男神演员！！】朝鲜时代进入景福宫的绝世美女画工红天机（金裕贞饰），和失明但可以读懂天空和星座的观象监河览（安孝燮饰），风流倜傥的亮明大君（孔明饰)，梦想成为王的周向大君(郭时旸饰)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人类的魔王同时存在展开的奇幻爱情古装剧。

programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, he explains that he was miming.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Go Jet Academy: Around The World In 80 Days
programme.desc: It's a rainy day and the team are stuck inside, so Foz reads them his favourite book: Around the World in 80 Days by Jules Verne. The Go Jetters are soon imagining they are characters from the story.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shadowlands
programme.desc: On a picnic in the park, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands. Coco keeps taking shortcuts so Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Favourite Thing
programme.desc: When Bluey accidentally makes Bingo upset playing a game at dinner, she will do anything to make her happy again - even changing the rules of the game. But nothing seems to work.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels prepare for a campfire by collecting sticks of all sizes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book. The Squirrels want to have a go too.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Irrigation
programme.desc: Uh oh! Glitch accidently uses his size-ray to shrink the Go Jetters and Ubercorn so that they are the size of ants!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bishop Rock Lighthouse, Isles of Scilly
programme.desc: Glitch plunges the sea into darkness in a night-time adventure near the Isles of Scilly.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S24) - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Star Renovation
programme.desc: Venus has attempted to redecorate the night sky, but now Sarah can't find any of her favourite constellations...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Flower
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help her find a new place for her friend Isabelle the Sun-bell Daisy. This proves trickier than initially planned as Isabelle has some specific needs.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Den
programme.desc: Little Woo and Seamus call Stanley to help them build a den so they can watch the bugs in the forest without disturbing them. Stanley builds a giant, camouflaged den on legs.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - My Grandad Sometimes Steals My Chocolate Buttons
programme.desc: From tickles and piggybacks to no longer being able to do cartwheels, grandparents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S1) - It's time for carnival
programme.desc: JoJo wants to celebrate the St Lucia carnival with Great Gran Gran, but it's too far away to travel to! Instead, JoJo and Gran Gran have their own carnival in the garden!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Pen Pal Badge
programme.desc: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Being Quiet Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - The Salmon Run, Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska's a cool place to watch the salmon run, but Glitch opens a 'fishy taxi service' to help the salmon avoid tricky waterfalls and greedy bears. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S2) - Festive Special

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits (S2) - Pak Choi
programme.desc: Pak Choi, who might be known by many names, sings about how she's "Always Pak To You!"

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Tato Tower Sleepover
programme.desc: Supertato invites Evil Pea to his sleepover, but Carrot is suspicious and vows to stay up all night to make sure she can't unleash any of her evil plans.

programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung's relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou's favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor's tomb.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters &amp; recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Driven by prophecy, Lord Conqueror murders Wind and Cloud's parents, then raises the boys as his own. Years later, their power rivals his, so he secretly plots their deaths. However, when his daughter falls for both young men, jealousy ignites. The moment he betroths her to Wind, a fatal battle becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Final Key
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere tells the kids that the failed mission is over, but Tony isn’t ready to give up, and he’s determined to rescue Frostee. The crew goes rogue by deciding to steal the final key from Shashi and trade it for their friend.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Arcadian Job
programme.desc: When Aja and Krel learn a secret, military base may house an alien spacecraft, they enlist Stuart to help them infilitrate it. Meanwhile, General Morando unviels his latest weapon - Omen, a deadly, cyborg assassin.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Truth Be Told
programme.desc: During her last days on Earth, Aja decides to tell Steve the truth: she's an alien. But her plans are complicated when the Zerons abduct Aja, Steve and Krel. Meanwhile, Vex struggles with an impossible choice: saving the Royal teens or the Royal Cores.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Last Night on Earth
programme.desc: With the Mothership ready for liftoff, Aja and Krel celebrate their last day on Earth at Battle of the Bands. But their world is rocked when Zadra arrives with a startling revelation about Vex - and a new enemy threatens their departure.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S2 - Agent AceSmoove As Ice
programme.desc: Chet can't get him on a cereal box, so Turbo makes Ace Gecko his sports agent; Smoove Move competes in a ski race to prove his worth -- all for love.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S2 - Disappearing ActSting Of Justice
programme.desc: When a bad magic trick makes Chet disappear, Turbo and Burn work together to find him; A superhero hornet arrives in Turbotown and stirs up trouble.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - The Fluffberg Method Singing Tele-Grammers
programme.desc: When Dr. Fluffberg is outed as not being a real doctor, Archibald must help him through medical school where students are put through the trials of a simulated hospital. Archibald dons the mantle of a singing telegrammer but runs into trouble when he loses the official "Grammer" songbook.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Farewell, General Sherwood Zoom Boomer
programme.desc: After a memorial for a famous tree that has fallen, Archibald discovers that Sage has never cried and vows to help his brother get in touch with his emotions. When Archibald wins the chance be shot from a cannon at the circus, he has no idea everyone in town is vying to be his plus one.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales S3 - The Frontier Fillies Great Legacy Race
programme.desc: The PALs are determined to place first in a race for the coveted Frontier Fillies Legacy Pin. But the BUDs are willing to do anything to win.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Hole In The Sky
programme.desc: After an emergency beacon draws Team Voltron to an ancient derelict Altean ship stuck in a temporal rift, the team is transported to an alternate universe.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Veggietales: In The House S2 - Ichabeezer's Granddaughter Gone Lobster
programme.desc: Ichabeezer's granddaughter, Maisy, comes to visit so Laura Carrot teaches him how to be a grandpaMotato's new favorite pet lobster goes missing

programme.title: Veggietales: In The House S2 - Bob Gets Glasses Crossing Guard
programme.desc: Everyone thinks Larry's a genius once he wears glasses, so Bob gets some tooLarry becomes a crossing guard but gets carried away with all the power

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesn’t want the others to hear what’s in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement can’t happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Talent Show Sad Sad Plant
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. But when it comes time, Scallop wants to keep the song "just for them", leaving Kelp to come up with anew act- and fast! The kids all visit the magical musical plant greenhouse on Unicorn Land. They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp it’s a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Detectives
programme.desc: There's a mystery in the dollhouse! For our COTD segment, CatRat and Baby Me-Owls show us how to make ice cube paints!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: When CatRat gets stuck on planet Caturn, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go save him. programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Home Alone

programme.title: Bliss - Baa Atoll, Maldives

programme.title: Recipes To Live By - EP11
programme.desc: During the prosperous Tang Dynasty, Ding Yishan became a "hellish food critic" because of his "golden tongue". He was both an enemy and a friend of the famous chef Gai Zhaotian. At the same time, he fell in love with the cheerful Hu woman Shi Rou. They then competed in cooking skills to determine who was better in terms of "taste". Yishan accidentally discovered his background. It turned out that his biological father died unjustly, and Zhaotian and his son were also suspected.

programme.title: Tiger Mom Blues - EP2
programme.desc: Raised by "Tiger Mom" YUE KAI-YIN (Michelle Yim), stay-at-home mom CHA HEUNG-SIN (Elena Kong), who is deeply influenced by her strict upbringing, adopts an autocratic parenting style to raise her two daughters, leading to resentment among them, especially her elder daughter YIM SIN-YUE (Kong Ka Man). The two are always at each other's throats.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP19
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP25
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Revolving Doors of Vengeance - EP28
programme.desc: Hotel tycoon WONG YUK TING’s family starts a legacy dispute immediately after his death. The third son KAI KIT (NG CHEUK HAI, RON) leaves home. His mother is soon forced to leave by his half brothers. Furthermore, KIT finds out that TING has transferred his hotel shares to a stranger KO FUNG, MARTIN (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE). _x000D__x000D_ FUNG comes for revenge. He swears to get hold of the whole hotel.

programme.title: ONE GOOD TURN DESERVES ANOTHER - EP3
programme.desc: Young and beautiful Yee (Maggie Cheung) was held responsible for murdering a millionaire for his estate. She employed Shek (Chan Kai Tai) to defend for her. Shek was attracted to her mysterious background and fell for her seduction._x000D__x000D_It turned out that Yee was in fact the step-sister of Shek’s wife Shan (So Yuk Wah). She blamed Shan’s mother for taking her father away and she swore to take revenge. She seduced Shek and made him divorce Shan.

programme.title: Colourful Life - EP7
programme.desc: The CHENG family has been running a business in the dyeing industry for several generations. Master CHENG and his wife died early. His mistress, SHUI KWUN DING FUNG (TSUI SUJK YEE), has since been running the business and keeps the family in shape._x000D__x000D_The eldest son, CHI SHING (LAW MONG), is a simple and straightforward person. He has a good and helpful wife, CHOW MONA (SO YUK WAH, LOUISA). The second son, CHI POK (YUEN SIU CHEUNG, LOUIS), is a short-tempered man.

programme.title: AI Romantic - EP4
programme.desc: High-end AI robot Bo (Ali Lee) accidentally loses her way while she is being shipped from the factory. She eventually ends up among a family of weirdos in the realm of human beings. AI company employee Koo Ka-lim (6 Wing) thinks he has found some treasure and arbitrarily keeps Bo for himself. To help four family members in the Koo household handle all kinds of strange tasks, Bo switches on her self-learning function and begins to experience myriad human emotions and desires.

programme.title: The Conquest - EP27
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第59集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大马慈济情第705集

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第109集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 行动现场第551集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 风月同天第58集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 365日日素第128集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透过简单的烹调方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 大爱真健康第602集
programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 映照人生第502集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 草根菩提第4085集
programme.desc: 有一群人用他们的生活响应 证严上人「用鼓掌双手做环保」的理念；在他们身上，环保居然可以和生活这么地贴近，而不是遥不可及的观念、数字或仪器。这是一群很特别的人，他们无时无刻都在想著如何让我们所住的地球更美好。

programme.title: 大爱全纪实第177集
programme.desc: 慈济四大八法推广与传播,关注地球与人类永续发展议题。 解读近代事件中，慈济「曾经」参与的足迹，至今「正在」持续的行动，以及留给「未来」的影响力。 为观众传播慈济四大八法，剖析探讨慈济人如何关注地球永续发展、推动拔苦予乐的希望工程。

programme.title: 人文讲堂第597集
programme.desc: 《人文讲堂》节目，邀请台湾各行各业杰出人士、学者专家，或热爱生命者，将多年的学识涵养、人文感受，以及对生命的活力，以讲演方式，直接与大众分享。讲演的内容及方式，不再流于传统，不仅是知识或专业技术而已，更会呈现出特有的人文观点。

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1370集
programme.desc: 中视推出悬疑益智实境节目《全民星攻略》！由幽默风趣「慧黠」的《馆长》-曾国城，引领明星、名人、网红，全民进击「九宫格攻略赛」，过关夺大奖！ 最悬疑紧张的过关氛围、最诙谐爆笑的「尔虞我诈」 ！最贴近「人生」的智慧题库！敬请准时一起来挑战-《全民星攻略》！

programme.title: 台湾味道4第1集
programme.desc: 以台湾这片土地上奋斗的小人物为主角的系列纪录片。这些升斗小民、寻常人家为追求他们的愿望、向往、志向、使命或执著，坚持著一种作为。这个作为，就是他们之所以活得精彩的故事，也是《台湾味道》探寻、撷取的影像题材、故事的基础。

programme.title: 台湾味道4第2集
programme.desc: 以台湾这片土地上奋斗的小人物为主角的系列纪录片。这些升斗小民、寻常人家为追求他们的愿望、向往、志向、使命或执著，坚持著一种作为。这个作为，就是他们之所以活得精彩的故事，也是《台湾味道》探寻、撷取的影像题材、故事的基础。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第511集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第1988集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.desc: 清荷元年开新局──葬神之野上，四心开天，九轮天启降世之道，天譩之间内，天譩以九轮共裁之身分，统合境内各大势力，强势入侵，更有逆三教首脑神机接应，这场策画多年的境界之战，势将动荡苦境江山，赮毕钵罗为首之一际云川、墨倾池主持的文诣经纬，地限所率领的道镇伏魔崖等三教势力，以及秉持黑暗正义捍卫武林的魔吞不动城，能承担九轮力压，为苦境中原开出一片光明吗？

programme.title: 天子传奇第23集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－纣王，好大喜功，征战连连，百姓为其榷税征租，贫乏穷困，哀声载道，民心渐失。一日在平魔的庆功宴时，代表大商国运的镇国龙龟猝亡，适时西现紫气，纣王视为必是西出妖孽，足以祸国，便遣妖帅调领大军征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬发，出世时天空出现异象，百姓皆称其为未来圣主。姬昌算易知悉姬发有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺险施行九鼎奇法，却因妖帅与九大护卫杀入，反成九五至尊之数。大祭司见弄巧成拙，建请纣王宣召姬发上京面圣，借机要将姬发炼制灵人，代替护国祥物，纣王为保王命，想尽办法不择手段，导致天怒人怨，因此种下亡国败运的祸根。 姬发面圣路上，灾劫连连，有飘渺城之困，却因祸得福习得「浑天宝

programme.title: 霹雳侠峰第29集
programme.desc: 北境三剑论侠峰，万魔之罪七皇踪， 河图鬼智计无谞，岳云深处现玉龙。 奉天逍遥踏入三途流域，又会开启怎样的旅程？名剑绝世与皇剑孤臣，能否解开白羽境天道之谜，阻止八歧邪神与死神？莫召奴、谈无欲、净琉璃等中原群侠，又该如何应对未知的危机？炼魔塔又是怎样的存在？逆神七皇究竟是哪七人？欲知一连串精彩发展，尽在霹雳侠峰。

programme.title: 一百种不老生活第17集
programme.desc: 从「生活的角度」出发，关心不同族群与不同世代，究竟这些前辈们都去哪里? 做什么? 说什么? 「100种不老生活」融合生活中多重方面的知识性及娱乐性，探讨乐龄学习的有趣过程，纪录他们的生命故事，感受他们不老精神。

programme.title: 新霹雳英雄榜第145集
programme.desc: 《新霹雳英雄榜》是一部动作冒险类型的电视剧或电影系列，为霹雳布袋戏的新一代作品。故事背景设定在一个神秘的武林世界，充满了武术、魔法和神秘力量。故事围绕著一群英雄人物展开，他们各自拥有独特的技能和身世背景。他们将面临来自黑暗势力和邪恶组织的威胁，必须团结一致，通过战斗和冒险来守护正义和保护世界的平衡。《新霹雳英雄榜》融合了激烈的打斗场面、刺激的动作场景和细腻的角色发展，带给观众一场震撼的视觉盛宴。剧情扣人心弦，充满著惊险、奇幻和神秘的元素，同时也融入了人物之间的情感和义务的探讨。这部作品以霹雳布袋戏的独特风格和特色为基础，结合了现代特效和技术，将传统和现代元素相结合，呈现出一个全新的霹雳世界。观

programme.title: 包青天第126集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.title: 我们的岛第1356集
programme.desc: 一个一小时的节目，能带给观众什么，能影响什么？如果把它只当成一个节目，会感觉短短一小时很短暂，如果把它当成一条出路，会发现力量也可以很强大，一直以来，我们节目的理念就是寻求一种改变的可能性，只要有一个人因为看过报导而改变了，反省也好，感动也好，警惕也好，行动也好，就有可能形塑一种新的环境公民力量，也有可能让错误的政策不再继续。1998年11月1日「我们的岛」节目正式播出，当年台湾的环境还处于大肆开发的年代，在经济挂帅的氛围中，「我们的岛」为环境发出另一种声音，至今「我们的岛」仍是台湾媒体中，唯一以「环境」为报导主题的新闻性节目，也是公共电视开播以来历史最久的新闻性节目，这十五年「我们的岛」制作

programme.title: 地球队好麻吉第6集

programme.title: 大自然生趣第23集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.desc: 探索野生生物在瞬息万变的人类世界中非比寻常的生存方式。

programme.title: 亚洲第1集
programme.desc: 亚洲拥有所有大陆中最长的海岸线与地球上最多采多姿的珊瑚礁。本集探索亚洲壮观且多样的水域，以及前所未见的动物行为。

programme.title: 亚洲第2集
programme.desc: 亚洲是地球上山地最多的大陆。从热带的南方到贫瘠的中心，其最高的地区是地球上一些最令人惊艳的野生动物的家园。

programme.title: 亚洲第3集
programme.desc: 在亚洲冰冻北方的偏远地区，生物必须克服独特的挑战，并在这个考验生命极限的险恶世界中找到特殊的方法繁衍生息。

programme.title: 亚洲第4集
programme.desc: 亚洲的丛林既美丽且极度多样，它们提供了庇护所、食物和机会，但同时也存在许多危险和隐藏的威胁。

programme.title: 亚洲第5集
programme.desc: 在地球人口最稠密的大陆上，动物和人类比邻而居。有在城镇安家的老虎，还有为了讨食而阻碍交通的大象。

programme.title: 亚洲第6集
programme.desc: 亚洲的中心地带有著广阔的干旱土地。这些沙漠和干燥的草原极为险恶，总是考验生命的极限。生活在这里的动物是地球上最顽强的动物。

programme.title: 亚洲第7集
programme.desc: 许多热心人士致力于拯救亚洲的野生动物。这些人和他们巧妙的解决方案让亚洲大陆的未来充满了希望与乐观。

programme.desc: 大卫艾登堡爵士一辈子足迹踏遍全球各地，如今他回到家乡，为我们揭露这块至爱宝地隐而不显的自然奇观。

programme.desc: 帕迪麦吉尼斯造访华伯顿工厂，他青少年时期曾在这里工作。
